name: braw-pack
creator: laurentchicoine
category: Encoding, codecs, proxy generation, rendering, and project servers
description: Experimental local BRAW archive and recompression utility. Rebuilds H.265 archives into usable BRAW while retaining camera metadata. Lossy: retain original footage until rebuilt clips are checked. Supports NVIDIA acceleration on Windows/Linux and VideoToolbox on Apple Silicon. macOS builds are unnotarized beta.

requirements.gpu: Optional NVIDIA acceleration on Windows/Linux; VideoToolbox on Apple Silicon; CPU encoding is available.
requirements.dependencies: Bundled FFmpeg; Windows GUI needs WebView2; Linux GUI needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1, glibc 2.38+.
requirements.installation: Portable downloads; macOS 12+ beta builds are not notarized.

history.name: laurentchicoine/braw-pack
history.summary: Repairs dropped-frame gaps by repeating the previous frame without modifying the source clip. Adds hardware HEVC encoding on Apple Silicon; macOS builds remain beta and unnotarized.
